scope: Four controlled native Montblanc RTV1 host-Mesa RGBA8 frames compared with resvg 0.45.1 rasterization of source-ordered triangle SVG prototype. Native rows flipped from GL origin; 256x256 viewport assumed. This is not a public Stroke export, native PDF, or device comparison.
model: Captured shader laws at four-subdivision patch vertices, analytic fwidth approximation and interpolated SVG gradients; fixed-function blend state remains unverified.
metrics: [native support, SVG support, intersection, union, alpha L1] where support is alpha > 0 and L1 sums absolute alpha-byte differences over the full frame
reproduction: Run .venv/bin/python tools/montblanc/compare.py with Pillow and resvg 0.45.1 installed. It verifies capture and framebuffer hashes, regenerates SVG, rasterizes it, and compares alpha metrics. To recapture, run the pinned capture script with PYTHONPATH=scratch/apk-analysis-runtime/python:tmp/vector-parity-plan/montblanc-drawing-capture-root-v2/conformance, --case CASE --output a fresh JSON path. Native dependencies and capture script live in ignored scratch/tmp and are not guaranteed in a clean checkout.
retained_captures: tools/montblanc/captures/{case}.json.gz; compressed complete native capture JSON, including VBOs and RGBA8 frame
